visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright festive graphic overlay featuring red and green checkered borders and Christmas trees. The text 'Cook & Dine with Hunny-Sweet Memories' is central, and below it, a row of yellow cookware items is displayed against a cream background. (2) Two men, one in a dark polo shirt and another in a white chef coat, appear in a studio setting. They stand on either side of a large yellow pot, smiling enthusiastically and gesturing with their hands toward the products. The background consists of a white screen decorated with honey pot and bee graphics. (3) The camera cuts to close-ups of the cookware. A man’s face appears in a circular inset at the bottom, pointing upward as the text for 'Winnie the Pooh' patterns is shown. The yellow lid of a pot is visible with clear branding. (4) A man in a dark polo stands in a kitchen environment, holding a yellow frying pan. He uses his right hand to emphasize the pan's features. Below him, icons of four different pot sizes appear. (5) A man in a chef's coat gives a thumbs-up in a kitchen while standing next to a pan containing cooked broccoli. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean cooking surface. (6) A close-up shows the white handle of a pan being gripped, followed by a man in the background holding his hands together in a thankful gesture. (7) A man wears oversized white and black Mickey Mouse style oven mitts, waving his hands playfully and smiling at the camera. Festive graphics like stockings and gingerbread men appear on the screen. (8) The final scene displays the full set of yellow cookware with detailed labels for each size. The text '型男嚴選 維尼而選' is prominently displayed at the top.
